assessments.rationale: The restricted mount attack requires an authorized user/users fstab mount with attacker-controlled ancestors. Inspection of this exact image found an empty /etc/fstab. The standard Compose service exposes no host block devices, privileged mode or user-controlled mount requests.

The vulnerable DOS partition parser requires probing crafted block-device metadata. The PostgreSQL service receives database protocol traffic and a named data volume; ROMD does not supply disk images to libblkid or expose block devices.

The restricted mount attack requires an authorized user/users fstab mount with attacker-controlled ancestors. Inspection of this exact image found an empty /etc/fstab. The standard Compose service exposes no host block devices, privileged mode or user-controlled mount requests.

The issue requires a single gzip invocation decompressing crafted LZW followed by LZH input. ROMD sends no uploaded archives to the PostgreSQL helper. Recovery accepts operator-trusted ROMD gzip/tar backups; it does not expose the affected mixed-format decompression operation as an application feature.
